params.name: offset
params.description: The number of artifacts to skip before starting to collect the result set.  Defaults to 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of artifacts to return.  Defaults to 20.

params.name: orderby
params.description:
The field to sort by.  Can be one of:

* `name`
* `createdOn`

params.name: labels
params.description:
Filter by one or more name/value label.  Separate each name/value pair using a colon.  For
example `labels=foo:bar` will return only artifacts with a label named `foo`
and value `bar`.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of all artifacts that match the provided filter criteria.

This operation can fail for the following reasons:

* A server error occurred (HTTP error `500`)

params.name: canonical
params.description: Parameter that can be set to `true` to indicate that the server should "canonicalize" the content when searching for matching artifacts.  Canonicalization is unique to each artifact type, but typically involves removing any extra whitespace and formatting the content in a consistent manner.  Must be used along with the `artifactType` query parameter.

params.name: artifactType
params.description: Indicates the type of artifact represented by the content being used for the search.  This is only needed when using the `canonical` query parameter, so that the server knows how to canonicalize the content prior to searching for matching artifacts.

params.name: content
params.description: Full-text search of artifact content.  Requires the Lucene search index to be enabled.

params.name: structure
params.description: Search by structured content elements (schemas, paths, fields, etc.) using a faceted format. Supports three formats: `type:kind:name` for exact match (e.g. `openapi:schema:Pet`), `kind:name` for cross-type match (e.g. `schema:Pet`), or just `name` for plain text search. Requires the Lucene search index to be enabled.
